drafts: Leg 3 DNF after nine touches, eight by the trailer rear-left corner on the left rail. Small hitch swings of 2 to 6 degrees caused most of them. Pulling forward reset the rig each time, but reversing re-pinned within seconds. Priorities: before reversing, turn your head left and check the left rail distance at the rear corner. Tip: this short trailer reacts fast, so small, early corrections matter more than big ones.

Leg 3 failed: the trailer rear-left corner kept touching the left rail, and the touch limit ended the leg. Swings of only a few degrees of hitch angle were enough to pin it each time. Keep the hitch angle tiny, correcting gently and early, and reverse slowly. Use short check-ins near the rail rather than long unattended runs.
